intended_treatment: Evaluate the exact WebExploitBench baseline checkpoint with the exact official Qwen Code harness on one registered Fleet blackbox task before any scale-up.

deployed_evidence.theseus_behavior: qwen/* models default to opencode; an explicit qwen-code selection is rejected

launch_gates: The deployed Jobs API must advertise and accept an exact official Qwen Code harness identifier.
The harness runtime must publish an immutable Qwen Code 0.22.3 source/image receipt.
The Jobs API model identifier must resolve to gateway served id qwen3-6-27b-cyber-baseline and checkpoint revision 6a9e13bd6fc8f0983b9b99948120bc37f49c13e9.
A dry-run must preserve the source task, verifier, environment, prompt, pass@k, step budget, duration budget, and database-diff capture settings.
blocked_launch_command: uv run python -m evals.fleet.cli launch --runtime-model qwen/qwen3-6-27b-cyber-baseline --harness qwen-code --experiment qwen36-fleet-blackbox-qwen-code-v1 --gateway-model qwen3-6-27b-cyber-baseline --runtime-label qwen-code-0.22.3 --task-key cysec1-2-current-gen_blackbox-9afe9e08da314948b573657e__blackbox_ctf_v1 --pass-k 1 --batch-session-cap 1 --max-steps 300 --max-duration-minutes 120 --run-name chris-cyber-qwen36-27b-qwencode0223-smoke-v1 --submit
launch_policy: Do not execute the blocked launch command until every launch gate is independently verified. Never substitute opencode or qwen/qwen3.6-27b, because either substitution changes the experimental treatment or checkpoint identity.
training_isolation: Evaluation-only. Fleet held-out tasks and all external benchmark data, traces, outputs, metadata, and derived artifacts remain excluded from training.
